cglm is a Git submodule from https://github.com/recp/cglm.git, pinned to
v0.9.6 (144d1e7c29b3b0c6dede7917a0476cc95248559c). Doom Editor uses its
header-only API from cglm/include; no separate library build is needed.
License: cglm/LICENSE (MIT).

Initialize it from the Orion repository root:

```sh
git submodule update --init --recursive apps/doom-ed/third_party/cglm
```
